title: MDI Weekly Update – Week of Oct 12, 2026
headline: MDI week in review: new coastal residence awarded in Palacios, structural plans out for review, care center and residential work moving forward
excerpt: Issued a proposal and scope of work for a new coastal residence in Palacios; the client accepted and the project is queued. Sent structural plans for an elevated coastal residence to the client for review and issued updates addressing builder comments on pilings and stringers.
